subject: COLUMN clause
notes: Rule: 'The COLUMN clause defines one or more printable items. If a COLUMN clause is not specified, the items are not printed.' (cite.py --check 13.18.14.4 -> OK §13.18.14.4 1)). Only entries with a COLUMN clause become ReportFieldModel placements; the compose method places only those. Probe p1.cob (2002): a `03 PIC 999 SOURCE WS-X.` entry with no COLUMN on a line alongside `COLUMN PLUS 3 PIC XX VALUE "QQ"` printed only '  QQ' (the SOURCE item not printed, and QQ is the line's first printable item at column 3). The VALUE-without-COLUMN shape is separately refused per §13.15.3 SR13 (conformance:cases/13.15-Report-group-description/pb853-report-value-without-column). No spec-derived golden pins the not-printed half; test-needed.
